data.body:
Fix implemented in worktree fix-b9b4 (RED→GREEN confirmed).

MECHANISM (verified by RED test): JiraDataCenterBackend.add_comment was a bare delegate to the transport, which hands body straight to the jira client — a 50,000-char decorated body reached the recording client unfitted under a 4,096 ceiling.

CHANGE:
- DC send path: add_comment now routes through _DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment, whose fit is outbound_comments.fit_preserving_marker over the comment path's own _truncate_dc_comment_body at comment_max_chars() — the exact composition Cloud's send uses (6724e79e8f). Marker-less bodies keep byte-identical behaviour; the operator warning stays in jira_family.sanitize_comment.
- Dedup-key consistency (the e339/103729e90c class): _DCSanitizer.fit_comment re-derived via fit_comment_as_sent over the same raw fit, so _diff_comments' key equals the marker-stripped landed body. Both sides changed together in one change; convergence pins updated (049e convergence test, DC characterization, DC two-pass convergence suite) to DERIVE expectations from the real send composition.
- WIRE-vs-REMOVE decision: DC's sanitize_comment WIRED (it is the send-side sanitizer the ticket describes; after the marker-preserving recomposition it matches the needed semantics exactly). Cloud's sanitize_comment REMOVED: Cloud's real send fit is fit_preserving_marker(body, AdfCodec.fit_outbound) inside acli_cli_ops.add_comment (serialized-ADF budget); the dead method's plain 32,767-char cap would cut RECONCILER_MARKER if ever wired — wiring it would reintroduce bug 5931. Removed _JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment, jira_fields._sanitize_comment, the acli.py facade re-export, and the FieldSanitizer.sanitize_comment protocol member (nothing calls it via the port; DC keeps its concrete wired method).

New test tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_send_path_comment_fit.py drives the REAL JiraDataCenterTransport + JiraDataCenterBackend with only the jira client stubbed; RED pre-fix on both the length fit and the dedup key, GREEN post-fix; in-limit and ceiling-0 pass-through pinned.

Gates: make lint 0, make typecheck 0, complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0 (stale=1 = allowed improvement), tests/unit/rebar_reconciler 3010 passed.

Unrelated pre-existing failure found while validating: state/test_ref_lock.py::test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote fails identically on untouched main (git cat-file 128 in a temp bare repo) — not introduced here; will file a discovered_from ticket.
